tables.name: Targoth Naming Method
tables.description: Two original engine-compatible methods. 80% remote mountain geography; 20% ancient sites/lineages. Inspired by Himalayan naming and the mystical remote mountain mood of Mount Targon. No special join rules.

results.name: Highland and Sacred Geography
results.description: An inherited place name based on passes, mountains, river valleys, old lookouts and mountain settlements. Direct compound joining.

results.name: Ancient Lineages and Sanctuaries
results.description: Names associated with long-forgotten watchers, hermits and older mountain lineages, joined to a landmark or sanctuary ending. Uses the original founder method key for compatibility.
